## Change

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues if any.
First contributions and draft PRs are welcome.

## Validation

List commands run and results. For runtime changes, include model architecture,
physical format, runtime/dependency versions and hardware. State checks not run.
Use synthetic fixtures where possible; do not attach weights, tokens or private paths.

## Evidence and compatibility

Describe any schema, CLI or runtime compatibility changes. Distinguish static
checks, generation smokes, measured quality and certification. Include relevant
documentation updates and clean-room provenance for new integrations.
